state.name: HCD 2026 State Income Limits (Revised)
state.note: In the PDF text layer the 4-person median (138,600) prints at the end of the row; it is placed at index 3 here, matching the stated Area Median Income.

extremely_low.label: Extremely low income
extremely_low.quote: the product of 30 percent times 30 percent of the area median income adjusted for family size appropriate for the unit

very_low.label: Very low income
very_low.quote: the product of 30 percent times 50 percent of the area median income adjusted for family size appropriate for the unit

low.label: Lower income (to 80% AMI)
low.quote: the product of 30 percent times 70 percent of the area median income adjusted for family size appropriate for the unit

moderate.label: Moderate income (to 120% AMI)
moderate.quote: nor exceed the product of 35 percent times 110 percent of area median income adjusted for family size appropriate for the unit

statute.family_size_rule: Family size appropriate for the unit = bedrooms + 1 (HCD regulation, 25 CCR 6932). Treat as ASSUMPTION until checked against the regulation text.
